title: Wzeks Hub
features:
Auto Mine — automatically mines your current stage (with stage teleport + lock-to-stage)
Auto Strength — trains at your best unlocked mine automatically, no walking needed
Auto Sell — sells your loot automatically (only when you have loot)
Auto Rebirth — rebirths on a loop
Stage Teleport — jump to any stage (1–26) instantly
Adjustable Mine Speed — slider to control mining rate
Modern draggable UI — clean toggle switches, minimize button, RightShift to hide/show
Live stats — real-time Cash, Strength, Rebirths, and best-mine display
